paper.title_en: Asymptotic advantage of quantum one-way and SMP communication for total functions
paper.abstract_en: We exhibit a total Boolean function on n input bits whose bounded-error quantum simultaneous-message (and hence one-way) communication complexity is in O(√(n)), whereas its randomised one-way (and hence simultaneous-message) communication complexity is in Ω(n). The same function admits a classical simultaneous-message protocol of cost O(√(n)) when the players share O(√(n)) EPR pairs.
